note: LONJAN, LONFEB and LONMAR form a month family keyed `lon`, and a curated [[group]] `pay` claims `lonjan` beside `value`. A variable belongs to one group, and the rule keeps this conflict fatal, so the build stops with a located configuration error naming the variable, the curated group and the month family, in a diagnostic build too. Before the fix it stopped with the bare `variable belongs to multiple resolved groups` `ValueError` from the metadata validator.
fails_if: `resolve_month_groups` (catalog_dependencies.py) stops checking each month member against the curated groups' members, so the build ends `pipeline_build_failed` on the validator's bare ValueError

sources.description: SCB register 1 delivers LONJAN, LONFEB and LONMAR, a three-month family named 'Monthly wage <month>', plus VALUE (101).
